gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-heebo: Neuropolitical spaces its letters apart like glowing neon tubing, every stroke the same line thickness. Heebo follows in a sans with a tall central band and curves that stop short, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-hind-guntur: Glowing tube letters, pulled apart one by one, then a body built like stamped metal with wide gaps where curves meet stems. Neuropolitical belongs big and brief.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-hind-madura: Hind Madurai fills each line with lowercase that stands nearly as tall as capitals. Neuropolitical brings the glow, neon-tube letters spaced apart, while this body keeps wide-mouthed s curves and ribbon-cut stroke ends.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-hind-mysuru: Neuropolitical lights up the top with spaced-out, neon-tube letters and big open shapes in every small one. Hind Mysuru then runs a sans with lowercase pressed close to ascender height, no thinning strokes, and an a left slightly ajar.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-hind-siligu: Letters pulled apart like glowing neon tubes define Neuropolitical, with big open shapes inside every small letter. And Hind Siliguri hums along beneath in a sans-serif of constant line weight, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-hind-vadoda: Neon glow meets quiet workmanship here. Neuropolitical does its best with spaced-out, tube-lit letters, while Hind Vadodara handles the steady work, with spacious gaps in its rounds and tall bowls on e and a.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-huninn: Neuropolitical stretches its neon-tube letters apart, each one glowing at a single line thickness. But Huninn does the grounded work in sans-serif, with lowercase rising close to cap height and crossbars as fat as the stems.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-inter-tight: Neuropolitical glows in spaced-out, neon-tube letters with open counters. Inter Tight does the quieter job, bending its lines like rope, with short ascenders and curve tails held well back from the body.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-karla: Neuropolitical pulls its neon-tube letters apart, even its t sharing one width between crossbar and stem. Karla meets that with a gaping c and a middle band so tall that lines look stocky, a friendlier, chunkier neighbor.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-kedebideri: Modern, glowing tube letters pulled apart one by one are what Neuropolitical does best, every stroke drawn at one thickness. Kedebideri handles the rest, with a skyward x-height and rounded letters that stay open and inviting.
